name: Flatcheez 2
source:
This is the story of a young boy named Yuuta who has just transferred to another school and is trying to live a normal life.
However, one day, Yuuta receives a strange, mysterious letter. It seems someone named Princess Alice sent it!
According to the rumors, she gives to those she has invited the 'ultimate pleasure'!?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE272232.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一个名叫优太的男孩的故事。他刚转学到另一所学校，正努力过上普通的生活。

然而某天，优太收到了一封奇怪而神秘的信。寄信的似乎是名叫爱丽丝的公主！

传闻称，她会把“终极快乐”赐给受邀之人！

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE272232.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
